title: BGP forms but large UPDATEs are dropped — MTU asymmetry on R2<->R3
symptom: eBGP session R2 -> R3 establishes, then resets repeatedly; small prefixes propagate, large UPDATEs cause flaps. CustA reachability is intermittent.

inject.note: R3 side is mtu 9000; PMTU is broken because some hops drop DF and ICMP.

ground_truth.root_cause: MTU mismatch on the R2<->R3 link (1500 vs 9000) — large BGP UPDATEs are dropped, session resets
ground_truth.fix: interface eth2 / ip mtu 9000 on R2 (or align both ends to 1500)
ground_truth.verify: BGP session stays Established under load; no further resets in 5 minutes
